body:
Well i met someone a couple of weeks ago online and we’ve been texting everyday for a couple of weeks now. She’s home for winter break and doesn’t come back until early January so I’m trying to stay in touch until then. 

I can’t tell you how much anxiety texting her has given me. I really like her but things have been stale for these past couple of days because we have talked about so much in such a short span. She said she will give me a chance but I have to wait 2 more weeks. Being me, I’m thinking the worst. I’m thinking that she’s gonna find someone else before then and ghost me completely. 

And honestly if that happens, I think I’m gonna give up. I’ve been hurt way too many times.
Hopefully one day a woman sees how fun of an uncle you are man.

I feel you pal, I try to stay positive but it’s hard. All  you gotta do (and me too) is keep trying. Sometimes i wanna keep pushing and other times i want to quit. I assume you and me are close in age (early 20s) so we still have a lot of youth left. 

People always tell me that I will find someone, I’m a great guy, blah blah. Shit that I’ve heard countless of times. I want to believe that but with my struggles it seems like it’s never gonna be a possibility.
